category_title: High-ability students with strategic attendance but low platform engagement
minimal_context: The student is asked to complete introductory algebra assignments on the ALEKS adaptive platform.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please log into the ALEKS adaptive platform and complete the introductory algebra assignments for this week.

STUDENT: I already accessed all the guided notes and study guides in the LMS. I plan to look at them about four or five days before the assessment.

TUTOR: What do you think about starting the ALEKS platform assignments now?

STUDENT: I stopped attending the regular class sessions after 3 weeks and missed most of the assignments since then. I am only going to attend the important class sessions like the reviews and exams.

TUTOR: Keep trying to use the adaptive platform for your coursework.

STUDENT: I am not going to use it right now. I will just wait and use the adaptive learning platform for about 2 hours at the very end of the term.

options.A: Prompt the student to apply learning principles by examining the tasks and LMS resources provided in the course, and to describe in writing which resources are appropriate for each learning objective.
options.B: Provide continuous, increasing amounts of work on the ALEKS platform, giving the student more and more introductory algebra assignments to complete throughout the duration of the term.
options.C: Monitor the student's progress weekly during counseling sessions, and continue to check in with the student and the introductory algebra instructor on a regular basis throughout the term.
options.D: Use contests as an additional motivation to complete more ALEKS problems, tallying winners at the end of a given period to earn prizes such as homework credit, technology devices, or bragging rights.
